cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

mechanism: A treats its party-report pupil missing kitchen time as ordinary incomplete homework, concealing personal interest in the cake within a full chronological account.
confusable: Not open interrogation about theft: A refuses to announce which detail matters, asking neutral surrounding entries along with kitchen time.
comparison: Party timeline disguising cake interest versus vehicle record disguising driver interest.
